processes.sitara_deal_data_correction: Investigating and fixing deal records (Sitara/Unify/Tagg prices, numbers, links, duplicates) after a mismatch is reported by risk, settlements or logistics.

processes.netco_book_and_access_setup: Collecting lists of users, books and portfolio codes and requesting system access or book setup for the new Netco/Sitara environment.
processes.daily_pl_reporting: Producing, explaining and sending daily P&L and position numbers to traders and desk heads, including caveats about missing deals.
